visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a static low-angle shot of a bright hallway with white-framed glass doors. A toddler wearing a red watermelon-patterned shirt and grey shorts walks into the frame from the left, carrying a plush tan octopus toy. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the child as they look down at their shirt, then back at the camera while holding the octopus. The lighting is soft and even throughout the indoor space. (3) In a wider shot, the child and another smaller figure walk toward the back of the hallway. The watermelon-shirt child turns back to wave vigorously. (4) The scene shifts to a different day; the child is now wearing a black t-shirt with a blue bird graphic. A cat-face sticker mask is superimposed over another child in the background. The child waves and screams with their mouth wide open. (5) Another jump cut shows the child in a light-colored printed shirt with yellow shorts (digitally added sticker). They wave excitedly toward the camera. (6) The child is then seen in a grey t-shirt holding a small toy fishing rod, waving it around while yelling. (7) Finally, the child appears in a dark blue 'NEW YORK' baseball-style shirt, standing with arms outstretched and mouth wide open in a loud goodbye gesture. (8) The video concludes with a pink screen featuring a small cartoon illustration of the child and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
